troubleshooting.title: Push Is Rejected Because the Branch Is Behind
troubleshooting.shortdesc: If the remote has commits you do not have yet, the Git Client blocks the push until you catch up.

condition.title: Problem
condition.p: A push fails and the Git Client reports that your current branch is behind its remote counterpart.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: Someone pushed commits to the remote branch after your last pull, so your local branch no longer includes the latest remote history. Git refuses the push to avoid overwriting those commits.

step.cmd: Pull the remote changes into your local branch.
Resolve any conflicts that the pull reports.
